hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "git fetch --quiet origin; git merge --ff-only --quiet origin/main 2>&1 | Out-Null; git config merge.keep-both.name 'Keep both sides of added resx keys and WhatsNew lines'; git config merge.keep-both.driver 'python tools/git/merge-keep-both.py %O %A %B %P'; exit 0"
